title: Story bed: ominous
description: Bass drones and a muted frame-drum heartbeat, low piano octaves with the tritone, bowed-vibes dissonances, the motif four times slower on low piano.
usage: Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a 1-4 kHz pocket for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py. All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
instruments: VCSL frame drum, bass drum, cymbal swell
selfReview: Drones, a frame-drum heartbeat, low piano octaves with the D-Ab tritone, bowed-vibes dissonances (Eb5 over the D drone is a deliberate minor ninth, quiet) and the motif four times slower on low piano. It is the most uncomfortable bed by design. Check on a phone speaker that the heartbeat and drones do not vanish (they live under 150 Hz).
